title: "Lab Template"
---

# Lab XX-YY — <Mission>

> 🟢 / 🟡 / 🔴 / ⚫ — <Level> — <Duration>

## Mission
State the engineering problem and what the learner must build.

## Learning objectives
By the end of this lab, you can:
- ...
- ...
- ...

## Architecture
Describe the target architecture and dependencies.

## Prerequisites
List tools, versions, Azure access, permissions and expected environment.

## 1. LEARN — Context
Give only the minimum concept required to execute the mission.

## 2. BUILD — Implementation
Tell the learner what files to create/edit and what they must accomplish.

Do not hide the engineering intent behind unexplained commands.

## 3. VALIDATE — Evidence
Define commands, expected output, automated validation, Azure evidence, and state/output evidence.

## 4. BREAK — Controlled Failure
Describe the learner-facing scenario without exposing the fix.

## 5. FIX — Diagnosis
Use:
**Symptom → Evidence → Diagnosis → Root Cause → Fix → Validation → Prevention**

## 6. CHALLENGE — Independent Engineering
Provide requirements and acceptance criteria only.

## 7. SOLUTION — Reference Implementation
Expose only after the learner completes the Challenge.

## 8. CLEANUP
Provide safe cleanup commands and verification.

## Definition of Done
The learner must prove implementation, validation, Break/Fix diagnosis, repair, Challenge, explanation, and cleanup.
